about.text: In Brazil, Requeijão is a type of cream cheese white in color (but not similar to the American notion of cream cheese, and may be better understood as "creamy cheese"). It has a mild taste and its consistency can vary from creamy solid to liquid.

sources.text: Portuguese whey cheese; Brazilian version is a creamy curd spread
Portuguese whey cheese; Brazilian version is a creamy curd spread

facts.v: The oldest, artisanal form: a solid, yellow product made from cow milk; when cooked until dark it is called crioulo
A firmer, creamy form that holds up to high heat
